evidence.observation: Growth begins at 2.938 Torr, consistent with 100 sccm Ar
Pressure rises monotonically to 3.208 Torr over 12 min at constant flow and temperature
Ar flow steady ~100 sccm, so rise is not a flow change
Thermocouple holds 750 °C with stable heater power ~45%
O2 exhaust sensor not installed; atmosphere/leak status unverifiable

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a flow-step / pump-isolation pressure test) to distinguish a growing exhaust restriction from an air in-leak; O2 sensor is absent so a discriminating pressure-vs-flow test is needed.
